name: SF Digital Collections
description: Free access to more than 80,000 archival photographs, manuscripts, documents, maps, oral histories, and audiovisual materials from SFPL's digitized and born-digital collections
fullDescription: DigitalSF, San Francisco Public Library's digital collections site, provides free access to more than 80,000 digitized and born-digital historical photos, documents, manuscripts, maps, oral histories, and audiovisual materials.
whatTheyOffer:
- Historical photographs of San Francisco
- Manuscripts, documents, and publications (including local newspapers)
- Maps and ephemera
- Oral histories and audiovisual recordings
- Born-digital collections
- Free to browse without library card
howToGetIt:
1. Visit digitalsf.org
2. Browse or search collections
3. View materials for free
4. No library card required for access
keywords: SF Digital Collections, digitalsf, historical photos, San Francisco history, archives, manuscripts, maps, ephemera, audiovisual
